以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
`CGC-SEG` 印的是 `w_us/n`（累積平均，數值會隨 n 上升而下降）。第一版 harvester 把 13 行印出來的平均值全部加起來，得到 0.54 s；同一批 log 的正確總量是 30.66 s（差 57×）。錯誤值的方向是『讓等待看起來不存在』，正好會把 GPU 瓶頸誤判成沒有瓶頸。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
prefill_certifiability.py 的 harvest_segments 第一版：seg_wait_us=544570 （把累積平均加總），實際 seg_wait_s=30.66。

它管轄的檔案：`scripts/check/prefill_certifiability.py`, `agent_harness/CONVENTIONS.md`
對『累積平均』型態的儀器輸出，只能取最後一行 × 它的 n；逐行加總沒有意義。

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
prefill 276.25 → 151.28 t/s（−45%）時，有效時脈是 1400 → 700 MHz（−50%）。純 1/f 模型預測應慢 2.000×，實測只慢 1.826×（差 9.5%）；run 2 同方向（預測 1.294×、實測 1.216×、差 6.5%）。⇒ 純時脈模型被**資料否證**（這個述句不需要任何擬合）。配 `t = 0.5575 ms + 4226/f` 得到一個不隨時脈縮放的地板 0.558 ms/token，佔冷態 3.620 ms 的 15.4%。這是「時脈掉 58% 而吞吐只掉 45%」的來源，也是目前唯一已知**不會**被散熱改善的部分。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
兩種錯誤讀法。第一種是拿「最高檔 / 穩定檔」直接除：618/1470 = 42% ⇒ 說「吞吐應該只剩 42%」＝116 t/s —— 比實測 151 低了 23%，因為它同時丟掉了**駐留加權**（700 MHz 才是有效時脈）與**不縮放的地板**。第二種是相信 `R² = 0.9987`：那是**三個點配兩個參數、只剩 1 個自由度**，它證明「這個形式容納得下資料」，不證明 0.558 ms 是精確值。可引用的只有方向性的兩句：純 1/f 與資料不符、因此存在不縮放的成分；量級要更多時脈台階才敢定。

它管轄的檔案：`docs/PREFILL250_THERMAL_TRANSIENT_20260916.html`, `scripts/check/powermetrics_gpu_freq_parse.py`
把吞吐的變化歸因給某個量（時脈、頻寬、頻率）之前，先驗**比例性**：若吞吐比與該量的比不一致，就存在第二個「不隨它縮放」的成分，而那個成分才是可動的目標。兩個數字都要報。

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
`thermal_launch` 只記啟動那一刻的快照，而一個臂的每一個 round 都可能落在不同的熱壓等級上（同一臂內實測差 34%）。於是「兩臂的 launch 都印 HEAVY」看起來像同熱態，實際上一個臂的一半 round 是 MODERATE。更陰險的是：被污染的那一臂的 median 會**偏向**某一邊，於是得到一個方向明確、看起來很合理的假結論。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
2026-09-18 的 down-combine A/B（旗艦模型）：`en-dc-on` 與 `en-dc-ctl` 的 `thermal_launch` **都是 HEAVY**，但 `en-dc-on` 的 `thermal_hist = {HEAVY: 8}` 而 `en-dc-ctl` 是 `{HEAVY: 1, MODERATE: 7}` ⇒ 後者的 median 高了 **69%**（4.69 vs 2.78 t/s），而池統計**完全相同**（hit 82.70 對 82.70、io 1967.3 對 1966.2 MB、draft accept 0.42857 對 0.42857）⇒ 那個「融合慢 41%」全是熱態。改看反序那一組（兩臂都全程 MODERATE）才得到真實的 +25%。

它管轄的檔案：`scripts/check/decode_sweep.py`, `agent_harness/engine_loop/traces/lessons.jsonl`

**一個 A/B 的兩臂必須有相同的熱歷程；判準是 `thermal_hist`（全程分佈），不是 `thermal_launch`（單點）。** 判別式：兩臂的 `thermal_hist` 的第一大類標籤要相同，且另一臂不得有對方沒有的更低標籤。只要一邊有 `MODERATE`/`HEAVY` 而另一邊沒有，那個 median 差異就不可歸因。緩解：改用同熱態的**那一組配對**（ABBA 的其中一組），而不是 `M = sqrt(AB x BA)` —— 後者會把被污染的 AB 一起平均進去。

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
The device-side pool-row digest reads the first `rows` ids (default 8 = n_expert_used) and digests the row each selects. At T=1 that is the whole operand, so the 6 decode graphs and the first 2-token graph were fully covered and everything agreed -- and the verdict went out as 'same ids, same rows, on every graph'. At T=2 the operand holds 16 ids and at T=8 it holds 64, so every multi-token graph of the run was a token-0-only reading. Widening to rows=12 exposed it on the next run: at the SECOND graph of the run, token 0's 8 ids are still identical across arms while token 1's differ (the S1 arm returns repeats of slot 0 where the anchor returns distinct slots), which is the real first divergence of the run -- one graph earlier than the localisation had placed it, and it explains a whole-tensor difference at a node (layer 1's MoE output) whose input activations, router logits, routing weights and token-0 rows were all byte-identical. The earlier 'first divergence' reading was not wrong about what it compared; it was wrong about how much it covered.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
Run 2026-09-17 10:22 (rows=12, probe = whole row, whole-tensor digests): graph 1 token 0 ids A=[2,105,7,9,5,106,1,84] B=[2,105,7,9,5,106,1,84] (identical), token 1 ids A=[8,0,50,4] B=[0,103,0,74] with slot 0 appearing twice in B and carrying the same row content both times; graph 2 (T=8) the same shape at token 1. At rows=8 (the default) those four positions were never read, and the comparator reported SAME for the whole graph.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-metal/ggml-metal.metal`, `Backup/compare_pool_row.py`

When a verdict is about an OPERAND rather than a tensor, the instrument's record budget must cover the operand's full size, and the verdict must name the prefix it actually covered. For a 2-D ids operand the first N rows are NOT a sample -- a ggml tensor is ne0-fastest, so they are exactly TOKEN 0, and the remaining tokens of the chunk are simply not in the reading. 'The ids are identical' then silently means 'token 0's ids are identical', and the difference it hides can be the whole divergence. Widen the budget and re-run before quoting the verdict; if the budget cannot reach the operand's size, state the covered prefix in the conclusion itself.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
The S1 localisation had been reduced to one sentence, 'the two arms consume the same ids and the same pool layout, yet the gathered bytes differ', and the pre-existing probe for it reads the weights from the HOST during graph ENCODING (op->src[0]->data + id*nb02). On the arm under investigation the ids are a graph-computed node, so at encode time that pointer is unfilled and the probe reports 16/16 out-of-range ids made of float bit patterns -- it tracks who last wrote the buffer, not what the consumer received. Moving the same read into the Metal kernel, submitted into the same encoder right after the consuming kernel, produced the answer on the first run: over 30 graphs, including the first single-token step, the selected slots hold byte-identical rows (probe = nb02 = 335872/450560 B), and on the 5 graphs where the rows differ the IDS differ. So the hypothesis the probe was built to test was refuted rather than confirmed -- and a digest-only instrument would have printed DIFF there and read exactly like a confirmation. Recording the id in each row is what prevented that false positive.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
Two interleaved-free A/B runs of 36 graphs each, probe 4096 B and probe = whole row, both gave SAME=90 DIFF=15 NOT-READ=0 with FIRST DIFF at graph 31 (ffn_moe_down-1.pool) and a different id in row 0 of every differing pair; the same-arm control (one arm, twice) was 99/99 SAME at both probe widths. At the first single-token step the layer-1 ids are still identical while layer 0's attn_norm output already differs, so the divergence is introduced in layer 0 and the routing follows one step later.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-metal/ggml-metal.metal`, `Backup/compare_pool_row.py`

An instrument that exists to decide 'is the SAME thing really the same' must record the INDEX the consumer used in the same record as the digest of the data behind it, and the comparator must read the index field FIRST. A digest alone cannot separate two different defects: 'the two arms selected different indices' and 'the same index holds different data' both print as one word, DIFF. Print them side by side, write the branching decision rule into the comparator, and make the 'no difference' verdict state what it does and does not license. Corollary for the probe width: clamp the probe to the row stride, then report the clamped width -- if the width equals the stride, 'identical' is a statement about the whole row rather than about a prefix, and that is a strictly stronger claim for the same code.

觀測（because）：
2026-09-18，`sft_prime/build_sft_prime.py --self-test` 第一版 11/16：第 8 格把 `PROVENANCE.json` 的 `builder` 改成另一個投影，而 `sft_common.reconcile()` 對「builder 不對」是**無條件**擋的（`--check` 與重建都擋）⇒ 沒先清掉它，第 9／10／12 格全部紅。實際只有第 8 格的斷言有病（它預期 `check_artifacts` 那句話，但 `reconcile` 更早 raise）。修法是兩步：斷言改成 `must not write into each other's directory`，並在下一格之前 `unlink()` 那份 PROVENANCE 再重建。

sft_prime/build_sft_prime.py 的 self_test()（第一版：FAIL 集中在第 9／10／12 格）

它管轄的檔案：`agent_harness/engine_loop/sft_prime/build_sft_prime.py`
自測的每一格必須**只弄壞它要測的那一件事**，並在下一格之前把狀態復原。注入若破壞了共用狀態（換掉一份被下游無條件信任的檔），失敗會**連鎖**，而症狀看起來像「後面那幾個 flag 壞了」。修正不是去改後面那些斷言，是讓那一格收拾自己的殘局。

觀測（because）：
agent_harness' three entry points (run_round.sh, gen_sft.sh, finetune/eval_round.sh) all pass --agent-import-path 'tb_loop.agents....' while setting PYTHONPATH to agent_harness/ itself, so 'import tb_loop' raises ModuleNotFoundError. All three were unrunnable, and bash -n reported them fine.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
「無差異」是關於世界的斷言（效應 = 0），需要功效；「功效不足」是關於儀器的斷言（量不出來），只需要散佈。把後者寫成前者的代價不是措辭：它會讓一個未測的問題被記成已排除的死路，而那個死路在別的 regime 可能不成立。附帶一條同族的工具陷阱：`cmd | head -N; echo $?` 讀到的是 `head` 的狀態，不是 `cmd` 的 —— 它會把「沒有匹配」印成 `rc=0`，讓閘門假性放行。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
2026-09-17 M5 的 overlap A/B（`CGC_PREROUTER` 開／關，各 4 個請求，temp 0，同 binary，池 8 GiB，開跑前 thermalpressurelevel=0）：A 臂 decode 3.64／5.25／9.30／7.30 t/s，B 臂 7.59／7.33／7.66／3.97；中位 6.28 vs 7.50（+19%），而判準是 10%。兩件事同時成立：(a) A 臂自身散佈 2.6× ≫ 判準 ⇒ 功效不足；(b) B 跑在 A 之後、環境更暖（prefill 17.6→31.6 對 28.9→41.7）⇒ 那 +19% 與暖機同向，是混淆。裁決是「不用它判」：M5 的死路判定改由上界論證承擔（`fill_wait = 0.000 ms` ＋ `queued/pred_total = 1062/64320 = 1.65%`）。同一輪的 rc 實例：`lsof -nP -iTCP:8080 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | head -2; echo rc=$?` 印出 `rc=0` 而沒有任何匹配行，一度被讀成「還有 listener」；實際 8080 是空的（同一個 for 迴圈裡的 `if ! lsof … >/dev/null 2>&1` 當時已回報 RELEASED）。

它管轄的檔案：`docs/M3_M5_CLOSURE_2026-09-17.md`, `docs/M4_M5_DELIVERY_M3_M5_CLOSURE_20260917_2100.html`, `scripts/run_server.sh`
**當一個 A/B 的預期效應小於判準、而單臂自身的散佈大於判準時，正確的述句是「功效不足」，不是「沒有差異」。判準：把單臂內的散佈與判準並列 —— 散佈 ≥ 判準 ⇒ 這個 harness 判不了那個判準。**

QUESTION: Is the rebuilt binary 6-12% slower on llama-bench prod25-stream than the 18:00 build, as §3 of the whitepaper listed as an open item -- and what is the correct way to close it, given that ab_interleave.py is a within-build instrument and the question is cross-build?

EVIDENCE ON HAND:
- [artifact Backup/llama_bench/matrix_s1kernel_rerun_20260915.md] Second run of the SAME binary: pp@0 108.12±0.66, tg@0 6.91±1.54, pp@512 103.25±12.65, tg@512 8.85, pp@1024 105.71, tg@1024 8.55, pp@2048 101.70, tg@2048 9.67, pp@4096 103.11, tg@4096 9.10.
- [artifact Backup/llama_bench/matrix_s1kernel_20260915.md] First run, same binary, 34 minutes earlier: pp@0 109.29, tg@0 8.67, pp@512 97.55, tg@512 6.72, pp@1024 79.88, tg@1024 8.49, pp@2048 95.89, tg@2048 9.03, pp@4096 81.52, tg@4096 8.33.
- [artifact src/llama.cpp/build/bin/libggml-metal.0.19.0.dylib] mtime 22:14 and llama-server mtime 22:14 -- no rebuild happened between the 22:30 and 23:04 runs, so the whole difference is measurement, not code.
- [artifact Backup/phase_decomp/ab_s1_20260915.json] The within-build interleaved control: p25-gputime across 3 interleaved rounds is 8.67/9.55/8.93 (max/min 1.101) with md5 28097996 identical every round -- a 10.1% repeatability band for a stable arm measured under the tighter interleaved protocol.
- [artifact Backup/llama_bench/llama_bench_prod25-stream.stderr.log] First-run cache telemetry hit 97.1% / reads 519501 vs the rerun's hit 97.3% / misses 16163 -- the two launches do not even agree on pool behaviour, so the drift is not confined to timing.

ALREADY RULED OUT (do not re-walk these):
- claim: The 6-12% deficit is a regression from this round's changes.
  why false: The same binary shows swings four times larger in both directions with no code change (tg@0 -20.3%, pp@1024 +32.3%). A mechanism cannot be responsible for a gap that the null run exceeds.
- claim: The 6-12% deficit is environmental drift, so a careful re-measurement would recover the 18:00 numbers.
  why false: That presupposes the gap was real and only its cause was unknown. The null run spans -20% to +32%, so the gap is inside the noise of the method; there is no 'true' value for a careful run to converge on. The rerun did land nearer the 18:00 numbers on pp, which is exactly what drift-of-this-size looks like and is not evidence about the code.
- claim: Close §3 with an interleaved A/B, since A1 requires interleaved paired ratios.
  why false: ab_interleave.py alternates arms within one build; §3 compares two builds, and the 18:00 binary no longer exists on disk. The interleave was still worth running, but for what it does measure: the within-build repeatability band (10.1% for a stable arm) and the S1 arm's own instability.

Ran llama_bench_matrix.py --arms prod25-stream a second time on the unchanged binary (Backup/llama_bench/matrix_s1kernel_rerun_20260915.{json,md}) and set the result beside the 22:30 run. Recorded eng-mh-0010 and added CONVENTIONS A6 (a paired ratio requires both arms to have measured the same window) and A7 (a gate quantity that is computed and discarded is not a gate quantity). §3 of the plan is to be re-marked as measured, not explained.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
This is what makes it safe to instrument a dispatcher with one line at its end instead of chasing each of its internal paths: for mul_mat alone there are eight `set_buffer(..., bid_dst, ...)` sites and not all of them are on any given call's path. The rule also has a visible consequence worth knowing before trusting a name: ggml gives every tensor a name, so an unnamed node arrives as an auto-generated `node_NNN`. When a fused group therefore ends at such a node, the row is emitted under THAT name and an explicit filter never matches it -- the row for the node you asked about simply does not appear. Measured: `norm-2` appears 41/41 in one arm and 0/41 in the other purely because the norm dispatcher fused its following MUL in one arm and not the other. So a node's presence in the stream depends on the fusion state, which depends on node order -- see the coupled lesson on ABSENT not meaning SAME.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-metal/ggml-metal-ops.cpp`

A capture placed at the tail of a Metal dispatcher must name `ctx->node(idx + n_fuse - 1)`, not `ctx->node(idx)`. Every dispatcher that can fuse ends by REPOINTING bid_dst at the last node it covered (`ggml-metal-ops.cpp`: `if (n_fuse > 1) bid_dst = ggml_metal_get_buffer_id(ctx->node(idx + n_fuse - 1));`), and the dispatchers that cannot fuse end in a constant `return 1;` -- so the same expression is correct in both cases. Getting this wrong silently mislabels a fused tensor as its first node.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
S1's only crash all day was a SIGSEGV inside ggml_compute_forward_mul_mat_id on libggml-cpu. The per-node dump showed the entire difference between the two arms in one line: baseline node #73 ffn_moe_gate-0 [CPU] src[2]=ffn_moe_topk_remap-0 [CPU] vs S1 src[2]=CPU#ffn_moe_slots-0# [NULL]. Layer 0's MoE FFN runs on CPU/BLAS (its expert tensor stays full-width at 82M vs 45M for blk.1), so its ids were a CPU graph input; the GPU table turned them into a Metal product that needed a cross-backend copy of a RESHAPE view.

它管轄的檔案：`scripts/run_server.sh`, `src/llama.cpp/src/llama-graph.cpp`
In a graph that mixes backends, establish WHO COMPUTES and WHO READS before inspecting values: dump the split table and the per-node backend first (GGML_SCHED_DEBUG=2), then talk about contents.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
Run 2026-09-17 10:29 (p25-slotgpu-churn, CGC_S1_TABLE_CHURN=1): 10 graph-level `TABLE-CHURN` lines, all with `SEL-DRIFT ... entries=0`, and the aggregate line `S1 slot-table: publishes=1599 clamped_selected=0 clamped_table=180687 changed_entries=572 consumed_changed=192 consumed_unchanged_publishes=198`. 它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/src/llama-context.cpp`

A diagnostic whose PRINT is capped is not a whole-run reading: the cap silently turns 'the first N instances' into 'the answer', and a negative conclusion drawn from it is a conclusion about the cap, not about the run. When an instrument prints both per-instance lines and an aggregate counter, the aggregate is the reading and the per-instance lines are samples -- so a zero in the samples can coexist with a non-zero total, and the total is what a claim must quote. Check the print cap before quoting a zero.

觀測（because）：
The pool-row digest (a POOL row records the id a MoE consumer used and a digest of the bytes that id selected) was extended with the slot->expert map so the comparator could separate 'same slot, different expert' from 'same slot, same expert, different bytes'. The obvious implementation -- look the map up in the dump path, where the ids have just been read -- is wrong here for a reason particular to the investigation: the dump runs at synchronize, i.e. after the whole pass, so it would have read the map as it stood AFTER any background fill that landed late. 'A fill landed after the consumer had already read' is exactly the hypothesis the row was being used to test, so the label would have been produced by the phenomenon under test. The map itself does not depend on the ids, so it can be snapshotted at encode time (immediately before the consuming kernel is submitted) and stored per capture; the ids are consulted later, when they finally exist.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
Instrument written 2026-09-17 (§9.18.7), not yet run. The contrast is measurable in the design itself: the same run's engine-side counter reports `consumed_changed=192` over one pass -- i.e. the consumed slot->expert map DOES move within a run -- while a hardcoded dump-time lookup would have shown one final value for every row and no way to see the movement at all.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-metal/ggml-metal-ops.cpp`, `src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-metal/ggml-metal-ops.h`

An annotation added to a reading must be sampled at the SAME instant as the reading, and if that instant is not the end of the step, the instrument must be built to run at the earlier one. Concretely: when a row records what a consumer SAW, anything that labels that row (which expert a slot holds, which owner a page belongs to, which generation a pointer came from) must be captured before or at the consumer, never at the synchronize point where the row is printed. The end-of-step state is a valid reading of its own -- but it is a different question, and it must not be used to label a within-step one, because the specific hypothesis such an instrument exists to test is usually 'did the thing that should have been in place before the read actually arrive before the read'.

觀測（because）：
The per-capture design was chosen over the cheaper one-array-per-layer design while writing §9.18.7. The three MoE nodes of one layer (gate/up/down) are captured within microseconds of each other and would all have read the same shared array, so a fill landing between two of them -- drift inside a single layer inside a single pass -- would have printed identically on all three rows. The whole point of capturing at encode time rather than at dump time was to be able to see movement within the step; a shared array would have undone that while looking correct.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
Design-level, verified only by the fixtures of the time (2026-09-17): the comparator distinguishes `own=none` (not annotated) from `own=[]` (annotated and empty), and the three-state token is what lets a run printed before the column existed ('OWNER CHANNEL ABSENT', every row UNCLASSIFIED) still produce the identical legacy verdict (`SAME=90 DIFF=15 NOT-READ=0`, `FIRST DIFF = graph 31 ffn_moe_down-1.pool`) as the historical run it is compared against.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-metal/ggml-metal-ops.cpp`, `Backup/compare_pool_row.py`

When an instrument snapshots a shared structure once per capture, store one copy per capture -- do not share one copy between captures that are being compared. A shared buffer makes the LAST capture's state the label for every earlier one, which silently deletes exactly the drift the captures were collected to expose, and it does so without any error: every row still prints a plausible value. The cost of per-capture storage is bounded and stateable (here: slot count x captures, arena grown on demand and capped with a printed warning when exhausted); the cost of a shared buffer is an unsupported conclusion. Corollary: if the snapshot cannot be taken (channel absent, arena full, key unparsable), write a distinct 'not annotated' token and make the reader treat it as absence of evidence -- never as an empty snapshot.
